selection_reasoning: These two tasks form a coherent multi-hop dependency chain. The player must first locate iron_ore in the environment (a navigation/exploration task), and then mine stone_brick_stairs which requires having found and being near the mining area. The logical dependency is that iron_ore is placed near or as a landmark leading to the stone_brick_stairs structure, so finding the iron_ore serves as a waypoint/prerequisite to locating and mining the stone_brick_stairs. Additionally, both tasks are observable and verifiable - iron_ore can be detected in the player's view, and stone_brick_stairs being mined can be verified by checking inventory or block removal. Neither task requires deep Minecraft crafting knowledge beyond basic navigation and mining.

edges.reason: Iron ore vein marks the path to the stone_brick_stairs structure; player must navigate past iron_ore to reach the stairs

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' is an observe/locate task — the player must navigate near the iron ore cluster (centered at spawn-relative [8, 1, 8]) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located it. The iron ore cluster spans [7-9, 0-2, 7-9] relative to spawn, so the center is [8, 1, 8]. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range on the flat field, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the iron ore, not just passing by.

Uses inventory_has because mining stone_brick_stairs with any pickaxe (including the provided wooden pickaxe) causes the block to drop itself as an item that enters the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 stone_brick_stairs in inventory, so having ≥1 confirms successful mining. This is preferred over mine_block event tracking because inventory_has directly verifies the player obtained the resource.

scene_description: A flat grass field with two key structures: (1) a prominent iron ore cluster at ~8 blocks from spawn serving as a landmark/waypoint, and (2) a stone brick staircase structure at ~14 blocks from spawn beyond the iron ore. The player must first find/navigate to the iron ore, then proceed past it to reach and mine the stone brick stairs. Player is given a wooden pickaxe to mine the stairs.
task_text: Find the iron ore vein, then navigate past it to the stone brick stairs structure and mine one of the stone brick stairs blocks.
design_notes: Iron ore cluster (3x3 base, 3 blocks tall pyramid) at ~7-9,0-2,7-9 serves as visible waypoint. Stone brick stairs structure (4-wide, 3-tier staircase) at ~13-16,0-3,13-16 is the mining target. Both in the positive X/Z quadrant, with iron ore closer to spawn. Wooden pickaxe provided for mining. Flat grass field ensures clear line of sight and unobstructed navigation. Air cleared up to y+10 removes any tree interference in the build zone.
